description: Each asset's own past 3-month return predicts its next month (time-series momentum, documented across 58 futures markets by AQR researchers). Approximation: long-only on 16 ETFs, holding every asset whose 3-month return is positive, cash otherwise. Falsified if it fails to beat buy-and-hold on risk-adjusted terms.
title: Time-series momentum 3-month · 16 asset ETFs (after Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen 2012, AQR)
